newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toho Life to maintain foreign securities holdings.
newsitem.headline: Toho Life to maintain foreign securities holdings.

text.p: Toho Mutual Life Insurance Co plans to maintain its holdings of foreign securities in the 1997/98 fiscal year at the same levels as the prior year, a company official said on Tuesday.
Toho Life had outstanding foreign securities holdings of 675.85 billion yen at the end of fiscal 1996/97, which ended on March 31, up from 429.37 billion yen in the previous year.
The official said Toho Life boosted foreign securities purchases during the last fiscal year due to the weakening yen and widening interest rate differentials between Japan and other countries.

The levels at which unrealised profits on its stock holdings would fall to zero are the lower end of the 17,000 to 18,000 range for the Nikkei stock index and the higher end of the 1,200 to 1,300 range for the broader TOPIX index, he added.
The official also said the company will maintain its holdings of domestic stocks at the previous fiscal year's levels, but it will change the mix of stocks in its portfolio.
